page.overview:
Who is Adamar Cadrow?

Prince Chancellor Adamar Cadrow was one of the archmages of the city of Aeor, and one of the three lead designers of the Factorum Malleus. As an NPC, Adamar was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Adamar was a very influential figure in the city of Aeor as the Prince Chancellor of the Cogence. He was also one of three archmages who held enough knowledge of the Factorum Malleus project to be able to recreate it.

Umleta recorded a meeting between two archmages, Adamar and Primarch Selena Erenves, and celestial forces led by Acastriel. The celestial explains the gods' plan to them and the recording shows the moment they learn the Obtenebrator has been destroyed and that the Factorum Malleus is in danger with Acastriel insisting the group must move to trigger the weapon quickly. The watching mortal avatars of the gods realize they must act immediately.

Adamar then joined the Aeorian forces in defense of the Factorum Malleus at the heart of the machine. During the ensuing brutal battle, he used Wish to cast Finger of Death, and even though S.I.L.A.H.A. succeeds on his save, the mortal avatar took massive damage. Later in the battle, S.I.L.A.H.A. cast Meteor Swarm which Adamar's failed to Counterspell; S.I.L.A.H.A. then successfully Counterspelled Selena's Counterspell. While Selena is badly injured by this spell, both Adamar and Acastriel are killed and three upper wards of the Latimus Princeps fail which turned the tide of battle in favor of the gods.
